Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — Q2 usage questions

Thanks for the time today, Marissa. Quick notes from our side: 
- We're seeing a big spike in nightly batch embedding jobs that is increasing token spend unexpectedly.
- Recent latency spikes on the recommendation pipeline are hurting conversion during peak hours.
- Security/compliance team asked about audit logs retention and whether we can keep logs for 13 months instead of the standard 12.

Next steps from Acme: can you share the Q2 usage breakdown and a proposal for a Dedicated plan with predictable throughput? Also want to understand options for a 12->13 month retention policy (is that possible via Private deployments or an add-on?).

Thanks,
Jenna
Head of Data Platforms
Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.example>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — Q2 usage questions

Hi Jenna — great to chat this morning, and appreciate the clear priorities. Summary of what we heard and proposed next steps: 

Summary of pain points/goals
- Unexpected token spend driven by nightly batch embeddings (primary cost driver).
- Latency spikes impacting recommendation pipeline during peak (target: 99th percentile < 120ms).
- Audit/log retention request: 13 months (one month over our default package).

What we propose
1) Usage breakdown: attaching the Q2 usage report (acme_q2_usage_report.pdf) with token and embedding breakdown per service, and a short analysis of the nightly job impact.
2) Dedicated capacity proposal: see attached proposal (redwood_proposal_v2.pdf) — recommends Dedicated Small pool with reserved throughput + burst to cover peak windows; this reduces per-token cost and gives predictable latency.
3) Retention option: we can offer 13-month audit log retention as a paid add-on for Hosted customers, or as part of Private deployments (customer-managed retention). I'll loop in Rishi for a quick technical run-through on options.

Proposed timeline
- This week: I’ll send the detailed proposal and a cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated).
- Next week: technical deep-dive with Rishi and your infra team to confirm latency targets and batch job changes.
- Decision target: by 2026-09-15 to align with contract renewal on 2026-10-01.

Immediate asks for Acme
- Can you share the Slack handle for the infra lead we should invite to the deep-dive?
- Any constraints on changing batch schedule (e.g., must run between 2–4am PT)?

If that looks accurate, I’ll circulate the proposal and a one-page cost delta by EOD today.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.example>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — Q2 usage questions

Thanks for the context, Jenna. Quick technical notes ahead of our deep-dive: 
- Nightly embeddings: we can reduce cost by configuring prefix caching + incremental embeddings and by moving heavy offline jobs to batched embedding endpoints (saves ~30–45% based on similar customers).
- Latency: Dedicated Small with GPU-backed instances and optimized kernel selection should keep 99th percentile latency under 120ms for your 2–4k qps bursts in peak windows. We'll validate with a short load test.
- Audit logs: 13-month retention is implementable as an add-on in the Hosted plan (we'll track additional storage charges), or native in Private; will need approvals for retention SLA.

I'll be available Tue/Wed 10–2 PT for the technical call. Please share the infra contact.

-Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
